headline: I'm Khanh Vo. I'm learning to catch what attackers leave behind.
intro: Final-year Information Security student at the University of South Florida with a data science background. I build, break and monitor things in my homelab, and document every lab I finish.
about: I'm finishing my Information Security degree at USF in December 2026 and aiming for a Blue Team or SOC Analyst role. My data science background shapes how I read logs: I look for patterns first, then dig into the events behind them.

Most of my practice happens in a homelab with a segmented network, a SIEM, an IDS, DNS filtering and remote access. I hold CompTIA A+ and Security+, I'm working toward CySA+ and BTL1, and I write up the labs I finish so the reasoning is easy to follow.
contactText: I'm graduating in December 2026 and looking for entry-level Blue Team and SOC Analyst positions. Based in Seattle, WA.
